summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for integrating Supabase cloud persistence and authentication into Movie Finder, implementing PBKDF2 salting and peppering, RFC 6238 TOTP 2FA with emergency backup codes, four role-based access control tiers, an administrative user management dashboard with a deleted records archive, configuration-only restore points, live system state display, security credential audit reports, and a cross-platform SQL schema for web app synchronization.
